# Sync-ZbxProxyConfig

## SYNOPSIS

Asks the server to send its configuration to proxies now.

## SYNTAX

```
Sync-ZbxProxyConfig [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixProxy>[]> [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Sync-ZbxProxyConfig cmdlet asks the server, with task.create, to send the current configuration to the proxies given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped proxies) now, rather than at their next configuration sync; it is the frontend's Refresh configuration. Every proxy the pipeline brings goes into one task. The command writes the task's id, and -WhatIf shows what it would ask.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Refresh a proxy's configuration

```powershell
Sync-ZbxProxyConfig -InputObject 'proxy-01'
```

-InputObject (position 0) takes a proxy's name, id or object.

### Example 2: Refresh every proxy

```powershell
Get-ZbxProxy | Sync-ZbxProxyConfig -WhatIf
```

Get-ZbxProxy writes every proxy, and the command asks for all of them in one task.

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixProxy>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
